panels.general_description: Axial contrast-enhanced chest CT with a round rim-enhancing lesion in the superficial soft tissue anterior to the chest wall.
panels.detailed_description: Axial CT slice in soft-tissue windowing: curved chest-wall soft tissue with a bright rib and costal cartilage, black aerated lung at the right, and heart and vessels at the lower right. A round lesion with a brighter rim and darker center lies in the superficial soft tissue anterior to the muscle and rib layer, at the upper left of the image (an image position, not the patient side), with a few smaller faint nodular densities nearby. No arrows, calipers or text are drawn on the image.
